culprit_citations.quoted_text: Loans, at estimated fair value (amortized cost of $ 370,055,950 and $ 430,925,365, respectively) | $ | 334,975,067 | $ | 398,113,300

findings.detail: The BDC GAV comparison denominator was reported as no_comparison even though the filing provides a March 31, 2026 loan fair value anchor of 334,975,067.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate check. The raw filing provides a usable denominator: the Schedule of Investments Grand Total fair value is 334,975,067, and the same amount is corroborated by Total Loan Investments and balance-sheet loans at estimated fair value. The flagged no_comparison state is therefore a real extraction/anchor gap, not an undecidable source issue.
